mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals labor market tightening, boosting corporate hiring and profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint demand expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) triggers Federal Reserve monetary tightening expectations, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL exceeds 310, or Rank IC is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,350,000 units signal a robust housing market and strong consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST exceeds 1350.0, or Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime (UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month), improving labor market conditions support corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in the post-recession recovery regime, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP level (GDPC1) above 22,700 billion dollars indicates strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 exceeds 22700.0, or Rank IC is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
